answer: At enrollment, require a one-use SMS code sent to a carrier-verified mobile number, then store a salted hash and permit only one active reward key per number. A weather task might ask whether a gale at the inlet could push a buoy that will wander off its route; many aliases still share one phone quota. Proposed phone-check fee: 0.03 POA per identity; 0.03 × 1,000 = 30 POA for 1,000 fake keys, versus 0.03 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: prepaid SIM farms and shared phones can bypass or unfairly block the rule.
